definitions.gloss: to push away; to shove off
definitions.explanation: To physically push someone or something away from oneself with force.

definitions.gloss: to reject coldly; to cast off; to refuse to help
definitions.explanation: To emotionally distance oneself from someone by refusing their pleas, requests, or dependence. Used figuratively to describe a cold or detached attitude.

notes:
USAGE:
{突|つ}き{放|はな}す is a godan verb. It is a compound of ⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ (to thrust) + ⟦{放|はな}す→放す：29986_hanasu⟧ (to release). The physical sense (sense 1) involves forceful pushing, while the figurative sense (sense 2) describes emotional coldness or deliberate distancing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{冷|つめ}たく→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧{突|つ}き{放|はな}す (coldly reject)
- {突|つ}き{放|はな}すような⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (dismissive attitude)
- {突|つ}き{放|はな}すような⟦{言|い}い{方|かた}→言い方：14165_iikata⟧ (cold way of speaking)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{押|お}しのける→押しのける：15778_oshinokeru⟧ means to push aside, focusing on clearing a path. {突|つ}き{放|はな}す emphasizes the force and finality of the action. In the figurative sense, ⟦{見捨|みす}てる→見捨てる：14130_misuteru⟧ (to abandon) is stronger and more permanent, while {突|つ}き{放|はな}す can be a temporary or intentional act of tough love.
